19.10.2023
1.
This is second bail application.

Earlier, the first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to revive after examination of the victim in MCRC No. 10140 of 2022 dated 23.03.2023.
2.

The applicant preferred this second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in connection with Crime No. 561/22 registered at P.S.- Sakri, Dist.- Bilaspur (C.G.) for the offences under Sections 363, 366, 376, 506 of IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of POCSO Act.
3. As per prosecution story, the victim was found missing from 01.11.2022 and was recovered on 04.11.2022 by the police.
Her statement was recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., where she had stated that the present applicant on pretext of marriage abducted and sexually exploited her.
On such complaint, the Police registered offences under Sections 363, 366, 376, 506 of IPC and 4 and 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the present applicant is in jail from 05.11.2022 and the victim has already been examined before the Trial Court as PW-1 where she has not supported the case of the prosecution, therefore, the application may be allowed.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State would submit that the victim has been examined as PW-1 before the Trial Court where in para 4, when the Public Prosecutor put the leading question,
she has admitted that in the month of June 2022, the present applicant sexually exploited her which finds corroboration from her statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.
6.
I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

7. From the perusal of deposition of PW-1/ victim, particularly in paras 4 and 5, when Public Prosecutor put the leading questions, she has stated that the applicant in the month of June 2022 had committed the aforesaid offence and at the relevant time her age was below 17 years, therefore,
in opinion of this court, present is not a fit case for grant of regular bail.
Accordingly, the instant bail application is hereby rejected.

Sd/-
